desc:
Welcome to Port-Marie!
Explore a French city full of emergencies, choose your role, and create your own story with your friends!

👮 Join the police, chase criminals, and keep the city safe.
🚓 Patrol the highways and respond to car accidents.
🚑 Become a paramedic, treat injuries, and save lives.
💰 Choose a life of crime, plan robberies, and escape the police.
🚗 Live as a civilian, buy cars, and explore the city.
⭐ Earn money and XP to unlock new ranks!

🎁 Join the Made In France group for 30% more salary!
👍 Enjoying the game? Leave a like and add it to your favorites!

🚧 The game is in Alpha. You may encounter bugs as we continue to improve it!
